title: CodePilot: All Your Agents, One Window
summary: A 50 s bilingual (Chinese + English) launch film for CodePilot, a multi-model AI agent desktop client. Opens on a hyperspace star-streak with 'Today Claude / Gemini / Kimi / DeepSeek... tomorrow another?', particles assemble into a dot-matrix logo on white, then a dark app window rises over a glowing planet horizon (Apple-keynote style). Feature chapters use one huge thin word (Ask, Switch, Extend) over the horizon, then a left-aligned bold line ('Say it. It gets done.') beside a real-looking dark chat UI. Model logos orbit the composer (7+ → 17+), and it ends on the app icon over the horizon.
fit_reason: Apple-grade dark minimalism with a clean chapter system (big word → UI demo) suits a premium software brand; bilingual text and space horizon are the only things to drop.

palette.mood: dark premium monochrome, near-black with a cool blue-violet planet-rim glow; one light interlude (#f2f0ef) for the logo

typography.display: thin/light neo-grotesk for chapter words (SF Pro Display Light / Inter Light) + bold grotesk for claims; PingFang for Chinese
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: huge thin single word centred for chapters; small bold two-line claim left-aligned beside UI
typography.notes: English claim on top, Chinese translation under it, tiny grey third line. Stat headers '7+' / '17+' in heavy weight.

text_animation: chapter word fades in sharp then dissolves with ghosting/scale as UI rises through it
Chinese subline types/fades char by char
claim lines fade-up with blur stagger
captions: none (bilingual on-screen titles act as subtitles)
motion: particle field converges into dot-matrix logo
app window rises over planet horizon with perspective
chat steps (Read page.tsx / Edit page.tsx) appear in sequence with green ticks
model logo chips orbit and fan out around composer
transitions: white flash from hyperspace to particles
graphic_elements: planet horizon arc with blue-violet rim light
light-streak lens flare under chapter words
rebuilt dark chat UI (composer, model picker, tool-call list, permission dialog)
ui_treatment: Real-looking dark app UI in a floating window, shown wide then cropped; demo of model switching via dropdown with cursor; cards tilted in 3D for skills.

sound.music: cinematic ambient electronic, slow build, ~90 bpm
sound.sfx: whoosh on hyperspace, soft UI clicks

signature_moves: recurring glowing planet horizon as the stage for every chapter
one huge thin chapter word (Ask / Switch / Extend) before each feature demo
model logo chips orbiting the composer with a growing count

best_segments.what: Hyperspace → white particle burst → particles assemble the dot-matrix logo
'Ask' chapter word over horizon glow, dissolves into composer UI
'Say it. It gets done.' left claim beside chat UI running tool steps
Model logo chips orbit composer, counter 6+ → 17+

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP: canvas particles for logo assemble, CSS radial gradient arc for horizon glow, rebuilt dark UI in HTML, logo chips positioned on an ellipse and tweened.
recreate.prompt: Dark Apple-keynote style SaaS launch: a glowing blue-rimmed planet horizon at the bottom of every scene, one huge thin chapter word fades over it then dissolves into a floating dark app window, bold left-aligned claim beside the UI, integration logos orbit the input box.
